hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>/dev/null; pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.md) pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; } || true
